notes:
What’s new in 0.1.29:
• Your converter controls are finally on the Admin page — pause, an overnight-only window, scan for files phones can't play, convert a whole show, and accept-all.
• Feature suggestions people sent you now have somewhere to be read.
• Posters: the filename parser was rewritten, and anything the computer isn't sure about waits for you under “Titles to check” instead of guessing.
• Click an actor to see what else they're in that you don't have.
• The Shy Little Dragon now has a picture on every page.
• Install Android 1.13 — it stops the phone remembering a computer address that no longer answers, and brings 26 campsite games with tournaments and computer players, subtitles, a watchlist and favourites.
